goal: Select the most reliable and efficient local model-agent combination for repository engineering work.
guardrails: head-to-head claims use common applicable tasks
judge points are advisory until calibration gates pass
budget: 20 tasks, three isolated trials per applicable task, per-task timeout from suite.json
held_out: sealed prompt and verifier variants not used while tuning model, adapter, system prompt, skill, or tool policy
decision: PROMOTE only when deterministic pass@1 meets target, pass^3 is at least 0.70, every guardrail holds, and quality-gated throughput is not materially worse than the incumbent; otherwise retain or classify as specialized.
